bullets.text: Curbing Fibre Rollout Obstacles - The UK government aims to tackle freeholder issues hindering gigabit broadband access to flats.
Wi-Fi 8 Testing Underway - **Broadcom** launches Wi-Fi 8 solutions, with **Rohde & Schwarz** validating performance.
Agility Over Legacy Systems - 75% of telco CEOs believe outdated IT systems hinder innovation in the telecom sector.
6G's AI Impact Uncertain - Only 7% of tech leaders see 6G as a priority for AI advancements, indicating a research focus.
Private 5G Convergence - **Ericsson** emphasizes the integration of private networks with neutral-host systems for enterprises.
AI Reshaping Telecoms - The rise of AI-driven workloads is prompting a rethink of network infrastructure and deployment strategies.
Sovereign AI's Telecom Role - Governments are prioritizing domestic AI capabilities, placing telecoms at the heart of this strategy.
Hybrid Gateways for Connectivity - **MediaTek** introduces hybrid gateways to ensure reliable connections in mission-critical environments.
